这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。

texts.zh:
在方舟舰[Root.GetName]储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
texts.en:
Deep within the Arkship [Root.GetName] storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value, it would likely not have ended up forgotten in a storage crate.

The technology was severely outdated, using data formats that predate several generations of Arkship systems. Some speculate that it may originate from the early days of the journey, perhaps even from the era when our species still lived on a planetary surface.

label.en: Attempt to recover the archived data.

texts.zh:
数据经恢复后，展示了一个古老的季节性庆典，它可以追溯到我们过往在行星上生活的岁月。它似乎是为了标记寒冷月份的流逝和自然的苏醒。社群成员聚集在一起，迎接温暖与光明的回归。人们点燃篝火，在参与者之间散播鲜艳的色彩。记录还描述了分享特制的甜点、共同歌舞，以及静静观赏季节中首批花朵绽放的情景。

尽管这种季节性变化在方舟号上已不复存在，但这些碎片让我们得以一窥祖先们曾经如何庆祝这一节日。
texts.en:
The recovered data shows an old seasonal celebration from our planetary past. It appears to have marked the passing of the colder months and the awakening of nature. Communities gathered to welcome the return of warmth and light. Bonfires were lit, bright colors were spread among participants. The records also describe the sharing of special sweets, singing and dancing together, and simply watching the first blooms of the season as they appeared.

Though such seasonal changes no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the fragments offer a small glimpse into how our ancestors once celebrated this fetsivity.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一个与年度周期交替相关的季节性庆典。它发生在一年中最黑暗的时期，那时白昼稀少，寒冷笼罩着星球的大部分地区。社区通过用灯光装饰房屋和公共场所来应对，将漫漫长夜变得明亮且富有节日气氛。人们聚集在一起交换礼物，分享异常丰盛的美食。

方舟舰上已不再有这样的冬天，这些数据展示了我们的祖先曾经如何用温暖与光亮回应最黑暗的季节。
texts.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a seasonal celebration tied to the changing of the year's cycle. It took place during the darkest period of the year, when daylight was scarce and colder conditions dominated much of the planet. Communities responded by decorating their homes and public spaces with lights, turning the long nights into something bright and festive. People gathered to exchange gifts and share unusually rich foods.

Such winters no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the data shows how our ancestors once answered the darkest season with warmth and light.

texts.zh:
该条目似乎描述了曾经在我们母星上很常见的一种个人庆祝活动。记录提到，这是一个标志着个人年度生命周期更迭的时刻。在这一天，家人和朋友会聚集在一起，为该成员及其度过的岁月举杯欢庆。这一传统似乎还包括共同分享专为此活动准备的食物。

尽管方舟舰上的生活如今遵循着不同的节奏，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经每年都会停下脚步，在众生之中为每一个独立生命的延续而庆祝。
texts.en:
The entry appears to describe a personal celebration once common on our homeworld. The records refer to an occasion marking the passing of an individual's yearly life cycle. On this day, family and friends would gather to celebrate the person and the years they had lived. The tradition seems to have involved sharing sustenance together specifically prepared for the event.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows different rhythms, the records suggest that our ancestors once paused each year to celebrate the continuation of a single life among many.

texts.zh:
修复后的微芯片似乎揭示了标记新年度周期开始的庆祝活动。我们的祖先首先会打扫他们的居住空间。随着太阳周期更替的临近，各个社区聚集在一起，为最后的时刻进行倒计时。新周期的到来伴随着明亮的灯光、舞蹈和广泛的庆祝。参与者还会记录下对来年的个人意向，即旨在指导未来行动和改进的“决心”。

尽管方舟舰上的生活现在遵循严格监管的周期而非行星历法，但数据表明，我们的祖先曾如何以对未来的持续希望来标记时间的流逝。
texts.en:
The recovered microchip appears to reveal celebrations marking the beginning of a new yearly cycle. Our ancestors would first clean their living spaces. As the renewal of the sun cycle approached, communities gathered to count down the final moments. The arrival of the new cycle was greeted with bright lights, dancing, and widespread celebration. Participants also recorded personal intentions for the coming year, resolutions meant to guide their actions and improvements in the time ahead.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows carefully regulated cycles rather than planetary calendars, the data shows how our ancestors once marked the passing of time with a continuous hope for the future.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一种以两人正式结合为中心的社会传统。根据记录，社群成员会聚集在一起，见证两人公开向彼此表达承诺。这些仪式通常涉及象征性的服饰、口头誓言，以及作为见证人出席的亲朋好友。

虽然方舟舰上的伴侣关系通常是通过行政系统记录，而非通过繁复的仪式，但档案显示，我们的祖先曾以隆重的仪式和全社群的庆祝来纪念此类结合。
texts.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a social tradition centered on the formal union of two individuals. According to the records, communities gathered to witness the pair publicly declare their commitment to one another. These ceremonies often involved symbolic clothing, spoken vows, and the presence of family and friends acting as witnesses.

 While partnerships aboard the Arkship are often recorded through administrative systems rather than elaborate rituals, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked such unions with considerable ceremony and communal celebration.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了曾在家园行星上庆祝的一个热闹节日。参与者身着精致的服饰并佩戴面具，在庆典期间暂时换上新的身份。数据中还提到了有组织的游行，装饰华丽的平台在公共空间缓缓移动，人群则跟随其后，载歌载舞。

相比之下，方舟舰上的庆祝活动要克制得多，受限于值勤周期和有限的资源。记录表明，在另一个时代，我们的祖先偶尔会抛开实用主义，转而追求场面与纵情。
texts.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a lively festival once celebrated on our homeworld. Participants dressed in elaborate costumes and masks, temporarily adopting new identities for the celebration. The data also references organized processions, decorated platforms moving through public spaces while crowds followed while dancing and cheering.

Celebrations aboard the Arkship are far more restrained by comparison, shaped by duty cycles and limited resources. The records suggest that, in another time, our ancestors occasionally set practicality aside in favor of spectacle and indulgence.

texts.zh:
这枚微芯片揭示了一项来自我们物种行星时代的季节性节日记录。它似乎是在收获季节结束时举行的，当时各个社群聚集在一起，为一年中采集到的食物表达感激之情。这场庆典也标志着一年中阴暗时期的临近，届时白昼将变得稀缺，寒冷的气候亦会回归。参与者们身着令人不安的伪装，或许是为了模仿或驱散想象中的灵体。

尽管方舟号的农业周期经过精心调节，我们也不再需要这些传统，但档案表明，我们的祖先曾以感恩、创意和一丝顽皮来纪念季节的更迭。
texts.en:
The microchip revealed the record of a seasonal festival from our species' planetary era. It appears to have been held at the end of the harvesting season, when communities gathered to give thanks for the food collected during the year. The celebration also marked the approach of a darker time of year, when daylight would grow scarce and colder conditions returned. Participants dressed in unsettling disguises, perhaps to imitate or ward off imagined spirits.

Though the Arkship's agricultural cycles are carefully regulated, and we do not have any need for these traditions, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked the changing seasons with gratitude, creativity, and a touch of mischief.

texts.zh:
微芯片揭示了一份文化记录。它展示了一种以缅怀逝者为中心的传统。根据数据显示，社群会为去世的亲友设立小型展示台，并用鲜花、食物以及与逝者相关的个人物品进行装饰。这种场合并非在沉默中哀悼，而似乎既有反思，又带有庆祝的色彩。

虽然方舟舰上的世代表更迭已经改变了我们纪念死者的方式，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经不仅拨出时间来悲伤，也用来庆祝那些塑造了生者的生命。
texts.en:
The microchip revealed a cultural record. It showed a tradition centered on remembering those who had passed away. According to the data, communities would create small displays dedicated to deceased relatives and friends, decorating them with flowers, food, and personal items connected to the departed. Rather than mourning in silence, the occasion appears to have been both reflective and celebratory.

Though generations aboard the Arkship have changed how we remember the dead, the records suggest that our ancestors once set aside time to grieve, but also to celebrate the lives that shaped those who remained.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录展示了我们的祖先曾举行的一种繁育仪式。那是一场向社区展示首窝卵的聚会。在家族成员和见证者的注视下，卵被小心地放置在准备好的筑巢空间内。仪式使用了装饰性的筑巢材料和具有象征意义的贝壳排列，并举行公共宴会以庆祝血脉的延续。

值得注意的是，记录表明这些产卵仪式曾经持续数周，涉及漫长的仪式和准备工作。相比之下，方舟舰上的此类事务处理得既迅速又私密，如今只需花费几个小时进行精心管理的流程即可完成。
texts.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip shows of a reproductive ceremony once practiced by our ancestors. It was a gathering during which the first clutch of eggs was presented to the community. The eggs were carefully placed within prepared nesting spaces while family members and witnesses observed. Decorative nesting materials were used as well as a symbolic arrangements of shells, and communal feasts celebrating the continuation of the lineage.

Notably, the records indicate that these egg-laying ceremonies once lasted weeks, involving extended rituals and preparations. By comparison, such matters aboard the Arkship are handled quickly and privately, nowadays it occupies little more than a few hours of carefully managed procedure.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在繁茂生长期延续的一种公社传统。记录中提到，人们会在茂密的树丛中聚集，培育奇特而鲜艳的果实植物，各群体之间会互相走访，观摩那些格外引人注目的生长成果。不同品种被排列在一起，构成了色彩、质感与气味交织出的复杂而生动的图案。为了在聚会期间促成稀有或奇特的花朵绽放，祖先们还会刻意改变湿度、养分和光照。

方舟舰上的生活几乎没有空间进行这种自发的耕作。如今，生长周期由农业系统严格监管，大多数菌株的优化目标是效率而非表达。
texts.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a communal tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of abundant growth. The records refer to gatherings in dense groves where individuals would cultivate unusual and vibrant fruiting plants with colonies visiting one another to observe particularly impressive growths. Different strains were arranged together to create elaborate living patterns of color, texture, and scent. Our ancestors would deliberately alter humidity, nutrients, and light to encourage rare or unusual blooms during the gathering.

Life aboard the Arkship leaves little room for such spontaneous cultivation. Growth cycles are now carefully regulated by agricultural systems, and most fungal strains are optimized for efficiency rather than expression.

texts.zh:
回收的记录描述了我们祖先传承的一项古老传统。档案中记载，人们会聚集在受控的活火坑周围，刻意将自己暴露在酷热之中，以此展示韧性与生命力。参与者将火焰塑造成复杂的图案，并向其中添加稀有气体和燃料，使火焰呈现出异乎寻常的色彩。随着火势升高，观察者们会吟唱并欢庆，将这一盛事视作奇观与集体仪式。

在方舟舰上，明火受到严格管控，因为它们会对基础设施造成高度风险。
texts.en:
The recovered records describe an ancient tradition practiced by our ancestors. The archive describes gatherings around controlled pits of living flame, where individuals would deliberately expose themselves to intense heat as a demonstration of resilience and vitality. Participants shaped the flames into elaborate patterns, feeding them with rare gasses and fuels that caused the fire to burn in unusual colors. Observers would chant and celebrate as the flames rose higher, marking the event as both spectacle and communal ritual.

Aboard the Arkship, open flame is strictly regulated as they cause a high risk to infrastructure.

texts.zh:
修复后的记录描述了一项围绕后代早期成长的传统。根据记载，当幼小的个体在巢穴外迈出独立的第一步时，家人们会聚集在一起。那一时刻似乎被视为一个微小但具有意义的里程碑，人们通常会通过鼓励、分享食物以诱导幼崽走出巢穴，以及亲友们的关注来予以庆祝。

在方舟舰上的生活，极少允许为个人里程碑举行此类聚会。
texts.en:
The recovered entry describes a tradition centered on the early development of our offspring. According to the records, families would gather when a young individual took their first independent steps outside the den. The moment appears to have been treated as a small but meaningful milestone, often celebrated with encouragement, shared food to coax the young ones out, and the attention of relatives and friends.

Life aboard the Arkship rarely allows for such gatherings around individual milestones.

texts.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了一项与我们祖先生命周期中的自然阶段紧密相连的传统。记录显示，在个体脱落旧外骨骼期间，人们会举行集体聚会。这些蜕皮阶段并非在隔离中进行，而是通常以仪式作为标志，旧皮有时会被装饰或保存，作为成长与新生的象征。一旦旧壳脱落，新形成的外骨骼便会被自豪地展示出来。

在方舟号上，蜕皮周期通常在受控的生物设施中管理，以确保安全与效率，并配备工作人员以应对任何可能出现的并发症。
texts.en:
The recovered entry from the microchip describes a tradition tied to a natural stage in the life cycle of our ancestors. They show communal gatherings during periods when individuals shed their old exoskeletons. Rather than occurring in isolation, these molting phases were often marked by ceremony and the old skin was sometimes decorated or preserved as symbols of growth and renewal. Once the old shells were shed, the newly formed exoskeletons were displayed with pride.

Aboard the Arkship, molting cycles are typically managed in controlled biological facilities to ensure safety and efficiency with staff to help if any possible complications occur.

texts.zh:
这段恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在大气高度饱和时期所信奉的一种传统。人们会聚集在特备区域，刻意将体内积聚的气体和化学副产品释放到周围环境中。参与者们会相互竞争，看谁能产生最绚丽或最奇特的化学烟羽。由此产生的云雾在空气中形成了变幻莫测的色彩和反应图案。旁观者们兴致勃勃地观赏，而那些气味最刺鼻的气体往往会引起围观人群的阵阵笑声。

如今在方舟舰上，大气系统严格监管此类排放，以维持安全的环境条件。
texts.en:
The recovered record describes a tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of heavy atmospheric saturation. Individuals would gather in specially prepared areas to deliberately release built-up gases and chemical byproducts into the surrounding environment. Participants would compete to produce the most vibrant or unusual chemical plumes. The resulting clouds created shifting colors and reactive patterns in the air. Spectators observed with great enthusiasm, while the most pungent gases often provoked laughter among the gathered crowd.

Nowadays aboard the Arkship, atmospheric systems strictly regulate such emissions to maintain safe environmental conditions.

texts.zh:
恢复的记录描述了我们祖先曾践行的一种充满活力的传统。根据记载，成群的人会聚集在开阔的岩石地带，进行有组织的掷石决斗。参与者互相投掷松散的石块，试图从对手的外层击碎或削下碎片。在冲突中掉落的小碎片有时会被收集起来作为纪念品，象征着韧性与友好的竞争。

在方舟舰上，此类活动显然会对基础设施构成威胁。船体完整性协议严禁投掷石块，这些竞赛早已从日常生活中消失。
texts.en:
The recovered entry describes an energetic tradition practiced by our ancestors. According to the records, large groups would gather in open rocky fields to engage in organized stone fights. Participants hurled loose rocks at one another while attempting to crack or chip pieces from their opponents' outer layers. Small fragments broken off during the clashes were sometimes collected as keepsakes, symbols of resilience and friendly rivalry.

Aboard the Arkship, such activities would pose an obvious risk to infrastructure. Hull integrity protocols strongly discourage the throwing of rocks, and these contests have long since disappeared from daily life.

texts.zh:
回收的微芯片描述了我们的水生祖先在母星深海中延续的一种传统。个体们会聚集在一起，共同潜入比平时栖息地更深的水域。这些潜水活动既是挑战也是庆典。深水区存在着奇异的地质结构和陌生、甚至危险的生命形式，使下潜过程充满了刺激与危险。那些抵达最深处的人往往会受到众人的钦佩。

方舟舰上的水生生境受到严格监管，深度因工程限制而受限。古老海洋那巨大的压力和无尽的黑暗已无法再亲身体验。
texts.en:
The recovered microchip describes a tradition practiced by our aquatic ancestors in the depths of their world's oceans. Individuals would gather to descend together into deeper waters than normally inhabited. These dives were both a challenge and a celebration. The deeper zones contained strange geological formations and unfamiliar, sometimes even dangerous life forms, making the descent both thrilling and dangerous. Those who reached the greatest depths were often regarded with admiration.

Water habitats on the Arkship are carefully regulated and depth is limited by engineering constraints. The vast pressures and endless darkness of the ancient oceans can no longer be experienced.
